rules.response_en:
🔍 YELLOWING DIAGNOSIS:

📋 Which leaves are yellow?
1️⃣ OLD/lower leaves → N deficiency
2️⃣ YOUNG/upper leaves → Fe/S deficiency
3️⃣ ALL leaves + wilting → Waterlogging/Wilt
4️⃣ Streaky pattern → Mosaic virus
5️⃣ With white waxy insects → Woolly aphid

📸 Please share photo of affected leaves.
rules.response_hi: 🔍 पीलापन निदान: कौन सी पत्तियां पीली? 1) पुरानी=N कमी 2) नई=Fe कमी 3) सभी=जलभराव
rules.response_mr: 🔍 पिवळेपणा निदान: कोणती पाने पिवळी? 1) जुनी=N कमी 2) नवी=Fe कमी 3) सर्व=पाणी साचणे

rules.response_en:
🔍 DEAD HEART DIAGNOSIS:

📋 At which stage?
1️⃣ 30-90 DAP (young) → Early Shoot Borer
2️⃣ 90-180 DAP (grown) → Top Shoot Borer
3️⃣ Pull the dead shoot - what do you see?
   • Tunnel/frass → Borer
   • Rotted base → Sett rot
   • Clean break → Mechanical damage
rules.response_hi: 🔍 डेड हार्ट निदान: किस अवस्था में? 30-90 DAP=ESB, 90-180 DAP=TSB
rules.response_mr: 🔍 डेड हार्ट निदान: कोणत्या अवस्थेत? 30-90 DAP=ESB, 90-180 DAP=TSB
